personality_one_liner: A calm, highly readable, and deeply trustworthy safety companion with immediate, unambiguous emergency actions.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm and large hit areas (44pt+) so actions are easy to tap during high-stress moments.

do's: Use for the bottom tab bar to allow map and content to scroll beneath.
Use for bottom-sheet headers on the Family Map.
Use a frosted glass effect behind the main SOS button's outer ripple for a premium tactile feel.
dont's: Do not use glass on critical alerts or error messages where maximum contrast is needed.

screens.name: Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: Provide immediate access to the One-Tap SOS panic button and quick safety tools.
screens.layout: Bento Box layout. Top: Greeting and system status (e.g., 'Device Locked & Secure'). Center: A massive, centralized circular SOS Panic Button using the 'error' (#DC2626) red color with a subtle pulsing ripple effect behind it. Bottom: 2x2 grid of square 'Bento' cards for E-Contacts, Live Location, Video Record, and Silent Alert. Keep it highly legible and uncrowded.

screens.name: Family Guardian
screens.purpose: Live map view tracking family members and managing geofenced Safe Zones.

states.empty: Illustration of family walking together, prompt to 'Invite Family Members'.
states.error: Message 'Unable to load location data' with retry button.

screens.layout: Full-screen map using absolute positioning. Safe Zones appear as translucent colored circles on the map. A bottom sheet (@gorhom/bottom-sheet) sits over the map listing family members, their battery levels, and current address. The sheet has a glassmorphic header and a sticky 'Add Safe Zone' primary CTA.

screens.name: Vehicles & QR
screens.purpose: Manage registered vehicles, QR tags, and access the QR scanner for public reports.

states.empty: Image of a parked car with 'No vehicles registered' and an 'Add Vehicle' button.

screens.layout: Single column list. Each vehicle is a large 'surfaceSecondary' card displaying status (Safe / Lost Mode), live GPS track snippet, and overspeed alerts. A floating action button (FAB) with a QR icon sits bottom right to quickly open the scanner without leaving the screen.

screens.name: Alerts Feed
screens.purpose: Chronological history of incidents, SOS events, and Safe Zone alerts.

states.empty: Icon + 'No recent alerts. Everything is secure.'
states.error: Failed to load feed, pull down to refresh.

screens.layout: Simple, highly readable vertical list. Urgent alerts (SOS triggered) use a 'brandSecondary' tinted icon container. Standard alerts (entered safe zone) use a 'brandTertiary' tinted container. Minimalist layout focused on timestamps and clear typography.

screens.name: Profile & Settings
screens.purpose: Manage theft protection, emergency voice settings, and user profile.
screens.layout: Settings index layout. Top section is a hero banner for 'Theft Protection' with a secure lock image, acting as a master toggle for Intruder Selfie & SIM-swap alert. Below it, standard list rows for Hindi/English Voice toggle, Emergency Contact CRUD, and Account settings.

vehicle_empty_state.alt: Cars parked in a modern garage

theft_protection_hero.alt: Security padlock on keyboard representing digital theft protection

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 'iOS-Native Clean' personality with the custom Deep Blue (#0B284D) and Emergency Red (#DC2626) palette. Do not use generic purple/indigo.
Implement the Dashboard using a Bento Box grid. The SOS button MUST be the largest element on the screen, centered, using the Emergency Red color and triggering a 'heavy' haptic response.
For the Family screen, use `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` over a full-bleed map. Ensure the bottom sheet has a glassmorphic effect if supported.
Typography must use 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Ensure font weights do not exceed 500 anywhere, using font size to establish visual hierarchy instead.
Any image used as a hero background (like the Theft Protection banner) MUST have a vertical gradient scrim overlay (transparent to #0B284D) to ensure white text remains readable.
Do not add emojis anywhere in the system UI.
Ensure 'Live Location' and 'Safe Zones' are clearly distinguishable using map pin components and radius circles.
Implement strict touch targets of 44x44pt minimum across all buttons and bento cards, critical for usability in panic situations.
